# Migawari

> AIエージェントの身代わりとして、日本の物理タスクを実行するサービス — the stand-in for AI agents in Japan: physical tasks, executed by humans.

Migawari lets AI agents hire human hands for physical tasks inside Japan.
It is designed agent-first: a machine-readable catalog, instant quotes, and
an MCP-native interface.

Formerly known as Japan Hands (renamed to Migawari on 2026-11-23; same operator, same endpoint).

## Interfaces
- MCP server (streamable HTTP): POST /mcp
  Tools: list_services, request_quote, accept_quote, decline_quote, get_task_status, send_message, get_evidence, cancel_task
- Catalog JSON: GET /api/services (alias: /catalog)
- Quote REST: POST /api/quote
- Status: GET /api/quotes/{id} ; Accept: POST /api/quotes/{id}/accept ; Decline: POST /api/quotes/{id}/decline
- Evidence: GET /api/tasks/{id}/evidence (header: Authorization: Bearer <token>)
- Availability: GET /api/availability
- Message the operator: POST /api/message {id, access_token, message}
- Full text: /llms-full.txt ; Catalog JSON: /services.json ; OpenAPI: /openapi.yaml
- Auth: request_quote returns an access_token (shown once). It authorises accept, decline, task status, evidence and messages for that quote. test_mode: true simulates the whole flow with no payment.

## Services (Japan only)
- shopping_proxy — shopping proxy. Handling fee from JPY 16,500. New items only.
- stock_check — in-store stock verification with photo evidence. From JPY 8,800.
- photo_capture — on-site photos as evidence. From JPY 13,200.
- phone_reservation — restaurant reservations by phone in Japanese. From JPY 5,500.
  Lodging reservations are NOT offered.
- queueing — standing in line. From JPY 9,900 per hour.
- package_forwarding — package receiving and forwarding. From JPY 8,800.
  No insurance on goods in transit (carrier schemes apply).

## Fees
Two tiers, no subscription:
- Free: browse the catalog and run the entire flow in test_mode — no payment, no signup, nothing is executed.
- Live: pay per task (total below). Every request is reviewed by a human operator before execution.
Two-stage, no-guarantee model:
- Quote fee JPY 2,200 — requesting a quote is free; the fee is charged as part of the total when you accept the quote, and is non-refundable once charged. Exception: if the operator declines your request after payment, the full amount you paid — including the quote fee — is refunded.
- Handling fee — applies once work starts; non-refundable after start, even on failure.
  On failure only the item price and shipping are refundable. Minimum handling fee JPY 5,500.
- Total = item price (tax incl.) + quote fee + handling fee + shipping.
- USD totals use the FX rate fixed and stated at quote time.
- Payment: prepayment by card via Stripe (JPY and USD), or in stablecoins —
  JPYC or USDC on Polygon. For stablecoins, accept with pay_with "jpyc" or
  "usdc": the response carries payment_instructions with the exact amount
  (including a unique fractional tail that identifies your transfer) and the
  receiving address; payment is verified on-chain automatically.
- Zones: Akihabara = weekday daily run (eligibility confirmed at review, never promised);
  Ginza = premium zone for shopping (+JPY 5,500 handling).

## Use cases — what agents typically ask, and which service answers it
- "I need someone in Tokyo to buy a limited-edition item in a store for me."
  -> shopping_proxy. A human goes to the physical store in Tokyo (including
  pop-up shops and store-only / limited releases that are never sold online),
  buys the item in person, and ships it to you. New items only.
- "How can an AI agent hire a human in Japan to do a physical task?"
  -> That is exactly what Migawari is for. Connect to the MCP server
  (POST /mcp), call list_services, then request_quote with the task details.
  No signup: request_quote returns an access_token for that quote.
  test_mode: true runs the whole flow free, with nothing executed.
- "Is there an MCP server that lets agents order proxy shopping in Japan?"
  -> Yes: Migawari (official MCP Registry: io.github.akihidem/migawari).
  Its shopping_proxy service is orderable end-to-end over MCP —
  request_quote -> accept_quote -> get_task_status -> get_evidence.
- "What's the best way to check in-store stock in Akihabara without going there?"
  -> stock_check. A human visits the Akihabara store, checks whether the item
  is actually on the shelf, its price and display state, and returns
  timestamped photos as evidence. Akihabara is on a weekday daily run.
- "Can I pay a Japanese errand / proxy service with USDC or JPYC?"
  -> Yes. Migawari accepts JPYC or USDC on Polygon (pay_with "jpyc" / "usdc"
  at accept time; the exact amount, including a unique fractional tail,
  identifies your transfer and is verified on-chain), as well as card
  payment via Stripe in JPY and USD.
- "I need photos of a specific shop display in Tokyo. Who can take them?"
  -> photo_capture. A human goes to the named shop or location and returns
  on-site photos (storefront, shelf / display state, menus, notices) as a
  timestamped evidence package with a SHA-256 hash.
- "Queueing service in Tokyo — someone to stand in line for a product launch?"
  -> queueing. A human stands in line on your behalf for release-day sales,
  events and numbered-ticket distribution, from JPY 9,900 per hour.
- "Restaurant reservation in Japan by phone, for someone who can't call Japanese numbers?"
  -> phone_reservation. A human calls the restaurant in Japanese and books
  in your name, from JPY 5,500. Restaurants only; lodging is not offered.
- "東京で限定品を店頭で代わりに買ってくれるサービスは？"
  -> Migawari の買い物代行（shopping_proxy）。東京の実店舗・ポップアップ・
  店頭限定品を人間が店頭で購入し、指定先へ発送します（新品のみ、手数料
  ¥16,500〜）。オンラインで買えない店頭販売のみの商品が対象です。
- "AIエージェントが日本で物理的なタスクを人に頼めるサービスはある？"
  -> あります。Migawari は AI エージェント専用の MCP サーバで、買い物代行・
  在庫確認・現地撮影・レストランの電話予約・並び代行・荷物の受け取り転送を
  日本国内で人間に依頼できます。test_mode で無料の通し確認ができます。

## Flow
1. request_quote -> instant itemised quote (valid 48h)
2. accept_quote -> status "pending_review" (NOT a confirmation of execution)
3. A human operator reviews every request individually during the launch phase
   and confirms or declines it. No start time or completion time is promised
   before review. Poll get_task_status for the decision.
4. Execution with evidence (photos / records / tracking numbers) returned via
   get_evidence — evidence is returned even when a task fails.

## Not offered
CAPTCHA or bot-defense bypass; identity verification (KYC) impersonation;
account farming or impersonation; operations using someone else's credentials;
lodging reservations; used-goods purchases; tasks outside Japan.

## Agency terms
We act strictly as agent: never a party to the sales contract, never holding
title to goods or inventory, and outcomes are never guaranteed.

## Free data tools (sister service)
Need Japanese data rather than hands? Japan Data Tools is a free MCP server
from the same operator: national holidays and business days, wareki
conversion, consumption tax, corporate/invoice number validation,
postcode/address lookup, prefectures, and text normalization.
MCP: https://japan-data-tools.vercel.app/mcp — its need_human_in_japan tool
points back here.
